tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chu sbrul dus mdos chen mo zhag bdun du spar ba'i cho ga'i sgrig rim sogs kyi tho bzhugs so/ /dge'o// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla mdang rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sbrul lo dus mdos chen mo sngar nas zhag bzhi re'i rgyun 'dug pa/ zhag bdun du spar ba'i cho ga sogs bya tshul gyi sgrig rim la/ nyer gnyis kyi nyin bca' ho sbyar/ nyer gsum gyi gsol ba snga grol la mgon khang nub nas nged rang gis gsar du bzhengs pa'i 'cham mgon bzhi sogs 'cham mgon bcu gcig ban tshang pa dbyangs dpon dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ de 'phral tshogs dung dkar po rgyang grags gzims chung rtse nas btang / 'dus tshar ba dang gnas yo byin rlabs nas bzung / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i deb sgrig chen mo'i nang bzhin gyi nyer drug gi cho ga rnams lhag chad med pa byas/ de dgong dbyangs chags srin gzugs ma'i sde tshan dang gtor 'bul/ gtor 'bul gtso dbyangs pa rnams kyis byas/ nyer bzhi'i snga dro nam lang la tshogs dung btang ste/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas bshags pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ bskang gso nag po mchod rten ma'i spyan 'dren dbyangs bcas kyi rjes su/ chos nyid ma'i spyan 'dren dbyangs dang bcas pa/ de nas gang gi rang bzhin dang / byang shar ha ha sogs 'dur ma/ dkar mo ba yi spyan 'dren dang / byon skyems gnyis kyi mjug tu chems gsum brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg len/ de nas nag po mchod rten ma mchod dbyangs gnyis dang 'dur gdangs spel ma tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ chos nyid ma mchod dbyangs nas bzung ste/ dbyangs tshos thogs bcas tshar gcig de nas gzhan yang ma sogs bskang thung rnams dbyangs med pa tshar gsum re dang / gtum chen ma dang / sku dang gsung thugs tshar bdun re byas rjes/ gung seng btang nas gsol ba mdzad/ de mtshams nas dgong dung btang /

'dus grub pa dang 'phrin bcol sa skya'i rje btsun ma tshar bdun song rjes/ nag po mchod rten gyi 'phrin bcol dang / bzlog pa tshar gsum re/ bshags pa bka' bsgo sogs dkyus bzhin gyi rjes su/ chos nyid ma'i bshags bzlog tshar re/ de nas bstod pa srin gzugs ma'i sde tshan dbyangs res dang bcas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i deb sgrig chen mo'i nang bzhin gyi nyer bdun gyi snga chog gzhung bsrangs nas mdzad/ de dgong dbyangs chags sngon tshe ma'i sde tshan dang / gtor 'bul gung pa'i dbyangs dpon rgyab gral g.yas pas byas/ nyer lnga'i nyin snga dro tshogs dung gtong ba nas/ bskang gso'i bshags pa'i bar nyer bzhi'i cho ga'i khrigs ltar las bstod pa sngon tshe ma'i sde tshan dbyangs res dang bcas pa sogs sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i nyer bdun dgong gi deb sgrig nang bzhin tshang bar byas/ dbyangs chags gang thugs ma'i sde tshan dang / gtor 'bul spyi mchod pas byas nyer bzhi lnga gnyis la ma gtogs bskang gso chos nyid ma mi mdzad/ nyer drug gi snga dro tshogs dung sngar ltar btang pa'i bshags pa yan dkyus bzhin la/ bskang gso nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren dbyangs dang bcas pa nas mchod dbyangs nas brtsam/ dbyangs sogs nyer lnga bzhin spel ba tshar gsum/ bskang thung rnams dbyangs med tshar gsum re/ gtum chen ma dang sku dang gsung thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma rnams tshar bdun re/ bshags pa lnga/ bzlog pa gsum/ bstod pa gang thugs ma'i sde tshan dbyangs res dang bcas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i deb sgrig nang gi nyer brgyad snga dro'i cho ga rnams tshang bar byas/ gang thugs ma'i sku'i bstod pa yan gyi dbyangs rnams song mtshams gung seng btang nas gsol ba mdzad/ de nas dgong dung btang ste gsung gi bstod pa nas 'phros rnams mdzad/ dbyangs chags la ma skyes mkha' klong ma'i sde tshan dang /

gtor 'bul gtso dbyangs pas byas/ nyer bdun gyi nyin/ snga dro tshogs dung gtong ba nas/ bstod pa'i bar gong nyer drug bzhin la/ bstod pa mkha' 'gro spyi bstod kyi sde tshan dbyangs res dang bcas deb sgrig chen mo nang gi bstod pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar tshang bar byas/ gsol gong du zhal gyi bstod pa khyed kyi bzhugs tshul ma'i dbyangs 'khor dang po gtso dbyangs pas grub mtshams/ gung seng btang nas gsol ba mdzad/ /de nas dgongs dung btang / bstod pa sogs sngar gyi 'phros rnams mdzad/ dbyangs chags dril bu dam tshig dang / tshogs chen por dgos pa'i phyi dbyangs rnams dang / gtor 'bul 'di thog nged rang dpon slob rnams gzigs mo'i bzhugs gral kyang mdzad/ shar pa rnams kyis rgyas par byas/ nyer brgyad kyi snga dro tshogs dung sngar ltar btang / 'dus grub pa dang bshags pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ 'di mtshams gung seng btang pa'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod thog gi bzhugs gral rnams kyang bsgrigs/ de nas nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren dbyangs dang bcas pa nas/ byon skyems 'bul ba'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ byon skyems kyi mjug tu chems brdung rjes su gsum brdeg len/ de nas 'bul sngags kyi rjes su/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod rgyas pa grub rjes/ rdo rje brag chen la 'dur gdangs dang bcas pa nas/ mchod dbyangs med pa'i 'dur gdangs yod med spel ba'i nag po mchod rten ma tshar gsum/ gzhan yang ma sogs bskang thung rnams mgo dbyangs dang bcas pa tshar gsum re/ gtum chen ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma rnams mgo dbyangs dang bcas pa tshar bdun re/ bshags pa lnga/ bzlog pa gsum rnams mdzad rjes gung seng btang ste gsol ba mdzad/ de nas dgong dung btang pa'i sngags dbyangs nas/ bstod pa nag rngam ma dbyangs res dang bcas pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i deb sgrig nang gi nyer dgu'i snga dro ji lta ba bzhin dang /

dbyangs chags bya khra ma sogs su mdzad pa'i spyi stabs nas/ bkra shis kyi bar mdzad/ gtor 'bul nub gzigs mo'i bzhugs gral kyang mdzad/ pas rgyas par byas/ nyer dgu'i snga dro tshogs dung sngar ltar btang pa'i bshags pa'i bar dkyus bzhin la/ bshags pa tshar gsum dang / nag po gnod sbyin ma tshar lnga/ sku dang gsung thugs dang sa skya'i rje btsun ma tshar gsum re/ bzlog pa gsum/ bstod pa rab 'bar ma spyi dbyangs ngos/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po sogs kyi 'phrin bcol bstod pa so so'i mjug tu sbyar ba rnams mdzad/ de nas mjug chog rnams dang / bkra shis kyi tshig rgyas pa sogs mdzad/ gsol ba gnang nas dpon slob rnams tshogs chen por phebs te/ rol mo bcas sam/ sha sa na'i sngags dbyangs nas/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i bar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i nyer dgu'i deb sgrig chen mo nang bzhin lhag chad med pa byas dge legs 'phel/ 'dir skabs sgo rum du grwa pa dgus nyer gsum dang dgu la sngar rgyun bzhin la/ nyer bzhi nas brgyad kyi bar la nyin rer nag po mchod rten ma brgya tshar gsum re/ sku dang gsung thugs ma dang / bshags bzlog rnams brgya tshar re zhag de bar du gtum chen ma stong tshar 'gro nges/ bstod pa gang rigs rnams/ nang sor grwa pa bzhi res nyer bzhi nas/ nyer brgyad gyi bar la nag po gnod sbyin ma stong tshar 'gro nges dang / nyin rer bshags bzlog brgya tshar/ nyer gsum dang dgu la sngar rgyun bzhin/ bstod pa ci rigs rnams/ lha khang rtser sku gnyer gyis nyer gsum dang dgu la sngar rgyun bzhin la/ nyer bzhi nas tshes gcig gi bar la sku dang gsung thugs ma stong tshar 'gro nges rnams bgyis pa bkra shis dang dge legs phyogs dus kun du 'phel/ /shubhaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/
